answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 178108 Country: India Title: Baby girl name Question: We want to name our baby girl Mehar Fatimah. Is it allowed? Please let us know the meaning if possible. Answer ID: 178108 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 719/569/B=8/1441) You may keep your daughter’s name Mehar Fatimah. It means Fatimah’s Moon. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
